card.name: Word before 'for' in single-use statements
card.fires_on: The word 'intended' right after 'is' or 'are' when a vial or product is described as having no preservative and being 'for single use only'. Also 'cause' in 'is cause for alarm/concern'.

modes.label: Single-use statement
modes.description: 'intended' after is/are following a note that the product contains no preservatives, just before 'for single-dose'.
modes.example: ELAHERE contains no preservatives and is<< intended>> for single-dose only.

modes.label: Cause for concern
modes.description: 'cause' after is/are in news text, just before 'for alarm' or 'for concern'.

card.writes: It makes the next word 'for' much more likely.
card.plain: It fires on the word just before 'for' in phrases like 'intended for single use only' or 'cause for concern'.
